xBRIEFInfo.description: Add four-focus specialist pass (A/B/C/D) to deft-directive-pre-pr before push.

narratives.Description: RWLDL pre-PR is a generalist self-review. Issues still leak into PRs (missing acceptance/tests, latent bugs, secret/log leaks, extra scope). Encode a four-focus specialist pass after RWLDL and before push, with one home in directive and product-repo pointers plus a Grok workflow.
narratives.UserStory: As an agent about to push a PR, I want four specialist passes (acceptance+tests, bug hunt, stealth/secrets/log leaks, regression+extra scope) so Greptile does not become the first reviewer of those classes.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) Author skills/deft-directive-pre-pr/references/four-focus.md and Phase 6. 2) Pin in agents-entry, AGENTS.md, preamble, skill-pin-policy, REFERENCES, evals. 3) Add .grok/workflows/pre-pr-four-focus.rhai. 4) Tests for the gate. 5) Product-repo PRs copy the workflow and add an unmanaged AGENTS pointer.

narrative.Acceptance: deft-directive-pre-pr Phase 6 and references/four-focus.md define passes A/B/C/D, evidence-required findings, dual-stop, and host fallback.
AGENTS.md managed pin, agents-entry, swarm preamble, REFERENCES triggers, and eval cases require four-focus before push; RWLDL-clean is not push-ready.
.grok/workflows/pre-pr-four-focus.rhai smoke-checks; CHANGELOG Unreleased records the gate.
